_comment: Zone Engine severity policy for the FloodGuard MVP. Edit this file to retune the Red/Yellow/Green risk rings — no code changes required, just restart the server (same reload rule as config/coverage.json). base_radius_km gives the starting radius per M3 risk band. water_level_rise_adjustment widens those radii only when a fresh, good-quality water_level_readings row for the location crosses a configured rise-rate tier; tiers must stay sorted ascending by min_rise_rate_m_per_hr. These are prototype placeholder numbers, not validated emergency thresholds — see FINAL FloodGuard sign-off process before any operational use.

water_level_rise_adjustment._comment: A reading only counts as usable if quality_status equals required_quality_status AND its timestamp is within max_data_age_minutes of 'now'. Otherwise the engine falls back to base_radius_km unmodified and reports degraded_confidence: true.
